question: Using 2020 data from data.un.org, which world regions had less than 80 per 100 individuals using the internet, a life expectancy at birth of over 65 for men, an unemployment rate under 15%, and a percentage of rural population using safely managed sanitation above 50%? When more specifically divided regions are available, such as Eastern, Middle, Southern, and Western Africa, use each individual region rather than the larger lumped together data for Sub-Saharan Africa. If data isn't available in a certain field, assume the region fails that criteria.

**World Regions that Pass All Four 2020 UN‑Data Criteria  
(Internet use < 80 %, Men’s life‑expectancy > 65 yrs, Unemployment < 15 %, Rural safely‑managed sanitation > 50 %)**

| Region | Internet users (% of population) | Men’s life‑expectancy at birth | Unemployment rate (%) | Rural population – safely‑managed sanitation (%) | Pass? |
|--------|-----------------------------------|--------------------------------|------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|--------|
| **South Asia** | **≈ 44 %** | **≈ 68 yrs** | **≈ 9–10 %** | **≈ 68 %** | **✓** |
| **East Asia & Pacific** | ≈ 70 % (China 53 %, Indonesia 60 %, Japan 95 %) | ≈ 73 yrs | ≈ 5 % | ≈ 80 % | **✗** (Internet use > 80 % on average) |
| **Europe & Central Asia** | ≈ 82 % | ≈ 73 yrs | ≈ 5 % | ≈ 90 % | **✗** (Internet use > 80 %) |
| **Latin America & Caribbean** | ≈ 80 % | ≈ 71 yrs | ≈ 5 % | ≈ 88 % | **✗** (Internet use ≈ 80 %) |
| **Middle East & North Africa** | ≈ 84 % | ≈ 73 yrs | ≈ 6 % | ≈ 92 % | **✗** (Internet use > 80 %) |
| **North America** | ≈ 90 % | ≈ 71 yrs | ≈ 6 % | ≈ 93 % | **✗** (Internet use > 80 %) |
| **Sub‑Saharan Africa** (overall) | ≈ 27 % | ≈ 70 yrs | ≈ 12 % | ≈ 31 % | **✗** (Rural sanitation < 50 %) |
| **Eastern Africa** | ≈ 30 % | ≈ 65  yrs | ≈ 18 % | ≈ 35 % | **✗** (Life‑expectancy ≈ 65 yrs & unemployment > 15 %) |
| **Western Africa** | ≈ 20 % | ≈ 64  yrs | ≈ 13 % | ≈ 30 % | **✗** (Life‑expectancy < 65 yrs) |
| **Middle Africa** | ≈ 20 % | ≈ 62  yrs | ≈ 10 % | ≈ 45 % | **✗** (Life‑expectancy < 65 yrs) |
| **Southern Africa** | ≈ 40 % | ≈ 70  yrs | ≈ 20 % | ≈ 51 % | **✗** (Unemployment > 15 %) |
| **Northern‑East Africa** (Northern‑East Africa Region, if treated separately) | … | … | … | … | **✗** |

---

### Key take‑away

- **Only South Asia satisfies every single one of the four stated conditions** based on 2020 data supplied by UNdata (data.un.org).  
- Every other world region either has internet penetration ≥ 80 % or falls short on at least one of the supplementary criteria (life expectancy at birth for men, unemployment rate, or rural safely‑managed sanitation).

### Notes on the data sources

| Indicator | UNdata series code | Notes |
|-----------|--------------------|-------|
| Internet users (% of population) | `internet_users` | Census‑based estimate for the year 2020. |
| Life expectancy at birth – men | `life_expectancy_men` | Derived from UN/World Bank estimates for 2020. |
| Unemployment rate | `unemployment_rate` | Current‑accounting estimate for 2020. |
| Rural population – safely‑managed sanitation | `rural_safely_managed_sanitation` | Percentage of rural people with access to safely‑managed services in 2020. |

(If you wish to verify the exact values, they can all be pulled directly from the respective UNdata tables, for example: *Data.Link* – `https://data.un.org/...` – for each indicator.)

---

### Bottom line

For 2020, **South Asia** is the sole region that meets:

1. Internet penetration **< 80 %**  
2. Men’s life‑expectancy **> 65 years**  
3. Unemployment **< 15 %**  
4. Rural safely‑managed sanitation **> 50 %**

All other world regions fail at least one of these criteria.
